e.summary: 香港与内地的保险实务、市场与监管
e.body:
本课程（必修）介绍香港及中国内地保险实务，讲师 Kelvin Cheung，教材为 Harrington & Niehaus《Risk Management and Insurance》与 Graves《McGill's Life Insurance》。

## 三大内容模块
- 保险市场：Mutual/Stock/Lloyds 所有权结构、价格监管、破产监管、法定会计要求。
- 财产与责任保险：汽车/屋主/商业财产/商业责任保险、政府资助再保险安排、巨灾损失的资本市场工具（[[insurance-linked-securities]]）、产品责任险（[[product-liability-insurance]]）。
- 人寿与健康保险：定期/终身/年金/健康保险、[[utmost-good-faith]] 核保、ILAS 投资相连、VHIS 自愿医保。

- 考牌关联：[[iiqe-2]]（一般保险）；同领域选修：[[rim533]]（财产与意外）、[[rim534]]（保险法） 属于纵深线 [[track-2]]（保险产品与市场深度）。 核保岗位（[[underwriter]]）是保险实务的核心角色。 理赔专员（[[claims-specialist]]）是保险实务的理赔端执行者。
e.body_en:
This course (Required, Mr. Kelvin Cheung) provides basic and intermediate knowledge of insurance markets, property and liability, and life and health insurance. The first segment covers the general theory of insurance markets; the second focuses on life and health insurance; the third covers business property and liability risk management, Mainland insurance law, and insurance market development in the Greater Bay Area.

## Core Modules
- Insurance markets: ownership structures (mutual, stock, Lloyd’s), price regulation, insolvency regulation, statutory accounting.
- Property & liability: automobile, homeowners, commercial property/liability, government-sponsored reinsurance, catastrophe risk financing via capital markets (ILS).
- Life & health: term, whole life, annuities, health insurance; underwriting; VHIS (Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme).
- Greater Bay Area and cross-boundary insurance development. It belongs to track [[track-2]] (Insurance Products and Market Depth). The underwriting role ([[underwriter]]) is central to insurance practice. Claims specialists ([[claims-specialist]]) execute the claims side of insurance practice.
e.body_hk:
本課程（必修）介紹香港及中國內地保險實務，講師 Kelvin Cheung，教材為 Harrington & Niehaus《Risk Management and Insurance》與 Graves《McGill's Life Insurance》。

## 三大內容模塊
- 保險市場：Mutual/Stock/Lloyds 所有權結構、價格監管、破產監管、法定會計要求。
- 財產與責任保險：汽車/屋主/商業財產/商業責任保險、政府資助再保險安排、巨災損失的資本市場工具（[[insurance-linked-securities]]）、產品責任險（[[product-liability-insurance]]）。
- 人壽與健康保險：定期/終身/年金/健康保險、[[utmost-good-faith]] 核保、ILAS 投資相連、VHIS 自願醫保。

- 考牌關聯：[[iiqe-2]]（一般保險）；同領域選修：[[rim533]]（財產與意外）、[[rim534]]（保險法） 屬於縱深線 [[track-2]]（保險產品與市場深度）。 核保崗位（[[underwriter]]）是保險實務的核心角色。 理賠專員（[[claims-specialist]]）是保險實務的理賠端執行者。
